title: Aligning Large Language Models with Human Opinions through Persona Selection and Value–Belief–Norm Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the frequency with which LLMs remove the 'Citizenship' attribute during the explicit persona filtering step across various topics to detect model sensitivities.
Tracking how frequently LLMs remove the 'Race' attribute during explicit persona filtering, revealing potential biases or over-sensitivities in the model's safety alignment.
Evaluating the removal rates of 'Religion' and 'Frequency of religious attendance' attributes during the persona selection process.
Measuring the frequency at which specific LLMs (e.g., Mistral) filter out the 'Gender' attribute when evaluating persona relevance for opinion prediction.
